name: popover
title: Popover
description: A small non-modal panel attached to a control, on Base UI's Popover: a trigger, and a popup on color.bg.overlay with an optional title, description, controls and a close action, placed on any side of the trigger.

manifest.name: popover
manifest.title: Popover
manifest.description: A small non-modal panel attached to a control, on Base UI's Popover: a trigger, and a popup on color.bg.overlay with an optional title, description, controls and a close action, placed on any side of the trigger.
manifest.usage: Use Popover for a few controls or a short explanation that belongs to one control and should not block the page: run options under an icon button, the details of a status badge, a colour picker. Compose it as Popover > PopoverTrigger (render a Button or an IconButton) + PopoverContent (side, align) > PopoverTitle, PopoverDescription, Fields, PopoverClose rendering a Button. It is not modal: the user can click elsewhere and it closes. For text that only names or explains a control on hover, use Tooltip; for a preview of a link on hover, HoverCard; for a list of actions, DropdownMenu; for a task that must be finished or cancelled, Dialog.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the trigger, a PopoverClose, Escape or an outside press opens or closes it.

props.name: modal
props.description: As Base UI: false lets the page be used while it is open.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: PopoverTrigger: opens on hover as well as on press.

props.name: side
props.description: PopoverContent: the side of the trigger it opens on; it flips when there is no room.

props.name: align
props.description: PopoverContent: how it lines up with the trigger.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: PopoverContent: the gap to the trigger in px; space.inline.xs at the trigger by default.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: PopoverContent: the element focused on open (default: the popup).

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own (PopoverContent: w-panel-sm for a fixed width).

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: In a portal at the end of <body>, at z.popover, with the trigger's data-theme and data-density, data-side and data-align; data-slot="popover-positioner".

slots.name: popup
slots.description: role="dialog", color.bg.overlay with elevation.overlay, at most size.panel.sm wide and the viewport's free height; data-slot="popover-content".

parts.name: PopoverTrigger
parts.description: Opens and closes the popover; unstyled, render a Button or IconButton through render. aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.

parts.name: PopoverContent
parts.description: The portal, the positioner and the popup.

parts.name: PopoverTitle
parts.description: An <h2> in type.body-strong that names the popup.

parts.name: PopoverDescription
parts.description:
A

in color.fg.muted that describes the popup.

parts.name: PopoverClose
parts.description: Closes the popover; unstyled, render a Button through render.

states.name: open
states.description: Opening: the popup grows from 95 % at the trigger and fades in over motion.duration.base with motion.easing.enter; reduced motion turns it off.

accessibility: The trigger has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded; the popup is role="dialog", named by PopoverTitle and described by PopoverDescription when they are there.
Enter or Space on the trigger opens it and moves focus into the popup; Tab moves through its controls and out of it, which closes it; Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger.
A press outside closes it; it is not modal, so the page stays usable and is not hidden from assistive technology.
An icon trigger is an IconButton with an aria-label.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off.
The popup takes the trigger's theme and density even in a scoped region, and sits at z.popover, so a popover opened from a dialog is above it.
